I deployed checkout-api v2.3.2 to all production regions and opened SEV3 incident INC-0001 to record the change.

- **Post-deploy health:** healthy in all regions, error rate 0.002.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 is open at SEV3 and recorded the change. It paged on-call, which is a side effect of opening any incident.
